name: qkd_layer_prog_img_r2-r2-COMMIT
purpose: Q-KVSYS PVJOIN 10-16 (lead-approved qkd_seq retirement, static KV path): all36 layer-programme roots as a compile-time image placed on the KV link compiler calendar (tools/qwen_static_kv/layer_roots_from_link.py: frames = link layer starts; attention run/issue from the CMD record edge; kgo/vgo from the KV calendar prefetch lead at T 8192 + PV_START; writer from the first KVN edge). Bench: cycle equivalence vs the boot-loaded module over 2 tokens (504 events) + every layer run of the real link calendar sequencer lands on its stage start at one fixed offset; mutants 1-4 FAIL. COMPONENT_TEST image: die path ages not measured.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_static_kv_layer_programme_img #(.MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_layer_programme_rom.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: layer_rom_pass
bench.pass_regex: ^LAYER_ROM PASS tokens=2 stages=72 runs=70 events=504 run_ofs=1 errors=0

bench.name: layer_rom_mut_writer
bench.fail_regex: ^LAYER_ROM FAIL tokens=2 stages=72 runs=70 events=504 run_ofs=1 errors=144 mut=1
